verdict.rationale: Godot documents a first-party command-line workflow for 'working entirely from the command line' and a `headless` display server with a Dummy audio driver for GPU-less machines. A runtime probe confirms a one-command keyless install to a binary that runs `godot --headless` for CI builds, exports and scripted editor automation. missing for 10: first-party docs specifically covering CI pipelines and headless export (the headless docs given are framed around dedicated servers), and documented headless execution of editor scripts (EditorScript is described as run from the editor menu).
